definitions.explanation: The state of a building, road, or other structure currently being constructed. Commonly seen on signs at construction sites.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{建設中|けんせつちゅう}です。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{建設中|けんせつちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高層|こうそう}ビル→高層ビル：16994_kousoubiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a high-rise building under construction in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦スタジアム→スタジアム：23905_sutajiamu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{建設中|けんせつちゅう}で、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The new stadium is currently under construction, aiming for completion next year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧ (construction/building) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during/in the middle of). The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ attaches to many action nouns to indicate something is in progress (e.g., ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧, ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧, ⟦{改装中|かいそうちゅう}→改装中：24572_kaisouchuu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建設中|けんせつちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧: a building under construction
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{建設中|けんせつちゅう}: currently under construction
- {建設中|けんせつちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: a road under construction

RELATED ～{中|ちゅう} EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction/repair (more general)
- ⟦{改装中|かいそうちゅう}→改装中：24572_kaisouchuu⟧: under renovation
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧: in preparation
- ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧: open for business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction — broader, includes repairs and road work
- ⟦{建築中|けんちくちゅう}→建築中：26158_kenchikuchuu⟧: under construction — emphasizes architectural building specifically
